syndrome: xor of exact partial-forward and partial-inverse boundary word; candidate survives width m iff low m syndrome bits are zero
target_generation: Python random.Random(seed), shuffle keys 1..1023, exclude every recovered prior target ID visible under /mnt/data/fds_recovered, take first 12

fair_baseline.method: direct exact final output word0 cone

accounting.note: Conservative: no QR reuse credit between screen and survivor verifier.

selection_rule: Among frozen widths, choose width with minimum median TOTAL QR over the 12 Stage1 targets; ties choose smaller width.
claim_limit: PASS is constant-factor screening only. Candidate enumeration remains 2^b and alpha<1 is not demonstrated.
next_if_pass: Freeze selected width and run an untouched fresh-target Stage2 total-cost confirmation before admitting a robust ranking/work constant-factor win.
next_if_fail: Close boundary-word syndrome as an end-to-end compute shortcut under this split/word; do not retune split/word because Stage0 found all 80 structural QR counts tied.
